variants.expected_speed: Fast: about 30 ms p 50 per decision on the BH card (raw, serial). The live file also carries an assumed-adjusted 0.21 s; that adjustment is an assumption, not a measurement. Provisioning class: RTX PRO 6000 96 GB; this names a memory class, not a latency measurement or confirmation of architecture compatibility. CPU/Mac speed is estimated only in separate portable variants.
variants.notes: min_vram_gb 24 is from BH meta.json; recommended 96 is the BH card, not a derived figure. Weights 8.41 GB bf16 on disk. Base Qwen3.5-4B. Requires the author shim and vLLM 0.30.0. Host RAM provisioning estimate: pinned weight files sum to 8.412 GB; ×1.25 loader/runtime allowance rounded up to 4 GB gives 16 GB. This is not a measured peak; FP32 initialization or duplicate weight buffers may require more.
